goalAttribution: Archived CHN scoring table and chart reconcile for both teams in every period. Only team-period buckets containing one scorer identity are linked; multiple distinct scorers remain unknown.
normalization: CHN display convention: mirror length only, using explicit home-start and odd/even fields. Unknown directions excluded.
membershipEvidence: Archived CHN team-season conference groups and unambiguous conference schedule labels. Unknown membership is excluded; Independent is never inferred from absent league games.

source.name: College Hockey News
source.limitations: Goal and on-net agreement does not establish complete miss/block coverage. Scorer attribution is partial and uses unambiguous reconciled scoring-table buckets only. No shot clocks, strength states, or trajectories.
